home.heading: Welcome to Golden Crane
home.introduction: A fictional Asian-fusion concept in Magdeburg, inspired by flavours and destinations across Asia.
home.conceptIntroduction: Golden Crane brings ideas from different Asian cuisines together in a creative demonstration menu. The names invite an imagined journey.
home.wokDescription: Noodles, rice and vegetables form the basis of many savoury dishes in this fictional menu.
home.sushiDescription: Maki, nigiri and small selections bring together different shapes, fillings and textures.
home.aromaDescription: Ginger, herbs and mild to spicy sauces add varied accents to the menu ideas.
home.highlightsIntroduction: Explore selected categories and their fictional dishes.

about.heading: About Golden Crane
about.introduction: Golden Crane is a fictional Asian-fusion restaurant concept with Magdeburg as its imagined location. It was designed as a web development demonstration project.
about.philosophyDescription: The demonstration menu combines familiar dish types with creative names drawn from Asian cities and landscapes. It is a design interpretation, not a collection of authentic regional recipes.
about.varietyDescription: Twelve categories show the range of fictional menu ideas, from small starters to sweet finishes.
about.balanceDescription: Flavours, images and short descriptions aim to create a clear, inviting menu.
about.atmosphereDescription: The concept uses a restrained restaurant aesthetic that gives individual dishes room to stand out.
about.craneHeading: The crane as a design motif
about.craneDescription: In this project, the name Golden Crane and the crane motif express lightness, calm and the idea of a journey.
about.menuIntroduction: Explore the twelve categories and their Asian-inspired house creations.
